dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Select the dashboards you want Loona to filter.

targets.title: Select accounts
targets.description: Choose **Selected accounts** or **All accounts**. Filtering only applies while an account is viewing a dashboard you selected. Home Assistant permissions always apply; Loona never grants or removes anyone's access.

filters.title: Filters and performance
filters.description:
Turn on the features you want. Always reload the dashboard after you make a change.

- **Entity filtering:** Sends only the entities your chosen dashboards use, plus any specific entities you added under Entity rules.
- **Device and area filtering:** Trims the entity, device, area, floor and label lists.
- **Live updates for current tab only:** After the first load, only the tab you are viewing keeps updating. Requires Entity filtering enabled.
- **Skip unused card files:** Prevents loading the card files that none of your dashboards actually use.
- **Delay graph loading:** Delays building graphs that are off-screen until the rest of the page has settled.
- **Idle mode:** After a period of no activity, the dashboard stops live updates and refreshes its values only at a set interval. Requires Entity filtering enabled.
- **Pause animations during loading:** Briefly pauses repeating animations while the dashboard starts up, then resumes them.
- **Pause off-screen animations:** Pauses repeating animations on cards that are scrolled out of view and resumes them when you scroll back.
- **Preload card files:** Starts downloading the current tab's card files before Home Assistant requests them.
- **Prioritize current tab:** Delays other tabs' card files until the current tab has rendered, then loads them gradually.

rules.title: Entity rules
rules.description: What gets sent to the dashboard is only what your selected dashboards actually use, plus whatever you add under Included. You can add single entities, a whole entity type (like `sensor` or `light`), or patterns such as `sensor.kitchen_*`, which means every sensor whose name starts with `kitchen_`. The Excluded list takes precedence over Included. Person, update and zone entities cannot be excluded, because the Home Assistant interface needs them.

To benchmark one of your own dashboards, you must add the benchmark card to it yourself.

confirm_remove_dashboard.title: Remove the Loona dashboard
confirm_remove_dashboard.description: Remove the Loona dashboard, along with its cards? An edited Loona dashboard is kept. Cancel to keep things as they are.

idle.title: Idle timing
idle.description: When Idle mode is on and you have not touched the page for the Idle after time, live updates pause. A fresh snapshot of current values loads at the Idle refresh interval. Changes in between are not displayed. Idle after is 1 to 60 minutes (default 5). Idle refresh is 1 to 60 seconds (default 60). At 0, values remain frozen until you interact. This affects ordinary live connections only - cameras, independent clocks, card timers and raw event listeners will keep going.
